column10: dig_threshold_desc:I started this strategy about 5-7 minutes into the experiment.  I realized it was inefficient to remain once I reached around ten-fifteen gems per dig.
column12: surprise_desc:I only used this strategy once I was already digging at a particular planet
column13: i.e. I never used this strategy upon the first dig at a planet.
column15: dynamic_desc:I used this strategy in conjunction with the goal of at least 10 gems per dig. Some planets definitely had a larger gem per dig average so I naturally stayed longer at these until the per dig number dropped below 10-15.
column18: feedback:The game was straightforward. It took probably half of the game time period until I had a clear and final strategy in place.}
